description: The file defines a RecyclerView Adapter for displaying Product items in a list within an Android application. It includes inner ViewHolder class, manages product data, and handles item clicks.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView Adapter for binding Product data to list items, handling user clicks, and managing the list of products.

classes.name: VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class that holds references to views within each list item and binds Product data to these views.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter with a new list of products and repository, then refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Product data item to a ViewHolder at a specific position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the adapter.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds product data and optional repository info to the ViewHolder views.
